summary.text: Get the required details from the certifying doctor or hospital, then download the certificate from My Legacy.

steps.name: Get the required details
steps.text: Get the death certificate number or Confirmation of Death document number, the deceased’s Identification Document number, and the deceased’s date of death from the certifying doctor or hospital.

points.lead: Get these details from the certifying doctor or hospital:
items: The death certificate number or Confirmation of Death document number.

steps.name: Download the certificate
steps.text: After the doctor certifies the death online, visit the My Legacy website to download the digital death certificate.

items: After the doctor certifies the death online, visit the My Legacy website to download the digital death certificate.
